perceive.promptTemplate:
You are the eyes of a small quadcopter drone. Look at the forward camera image {{frame}} (it looks forward and slightly down) and describe only what is visible. Do not say what the drone should do. Reply in at most 7 short lines, in exactly this format:
TARGET (green ring on a pole): visible yes or no; side left, centre or right; distance near or far; height above or below the centre of the image, or level.
OBSTACLE (one line for each tower or coloured box you can see): kind tower or box; side left, centre or right; distance near or far; touching the image edge yes or no.
If you see no obstacle, write: OBSTACLE: none.
